name: Warrior of Sunlight
description: (Tag:anti-undead)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:vitality+)You are a Warrior of Sunlight, praising the sun and devoting faith to it to receive power in return. You possess increased vitality. All your Lightning and Fire-based abilities are slightly more potent and carry traces of sunlight, further increasing potency against Undead and Dragons. Beings aligned with Sun and Light may favor you more.
